★★★★★

"I visited Shokoladehuset Sarah today and I was really impressed. The dessert tasted amazing and the service was incredibly friendly and welcoming. It is a very cozy, beautiful and quiet place where you can enjoy a good cup of coffee and a delicious dessert. I can definitely recommend the place to everyone."

★★★☆☆

"We were a small group, for coffee and cake the staff were nice and moved tables together so we could sit next to each other, the coffees were ready, but not particularly hot, the waffles and pancakes were boring, dry, and had the feel of industrial frozen products. A shame when there would be an opportunity to pamper the guests with homemade products. And lastly, I ordered crepes, but got a large thick pancake."

— René Tutak
★☆☆☆☆

"Beware! Tourist trap! Ordered 4 x Milkshakes with Oreos. It was milk with ice cubes!!! It didn't taste good. Maybe they should blend the ice cubes so it just reminds a bit of a Milkshake. The staff seemed inexperienced and confused. We won't be back. Definitely not worth 220,- kroner."

— Ragnar Lothbrok
03 / FAQ

Spørgsmål & svar

Har du et spørgsmål der ikke er besvaret her? Ring direkte — vi er her for at hjælpe.

93 80 66 07 →
Skal jeg kontakte jer i god tid? +
Ja, vi anbefaler at du kontakter os i god tid, så vi kan finde det rette tidspunkt til din henvendelse.
Hvilke områder dækker I? +
Vi dækker Åbenrå og de nærmeste omegnskommuner. Ring til os, hvis du er i tvivl om afstand.
Hvordan får jeg et tilbud? +
Ring eller skriv til os, så vender vi hurtigt tilbage med et uforpligtende tilbud eller en tid.
Er I forsikrede og godkendte? +
Ja, vi arbejder efter gældende regler og standarder inden for konditor-faget.
Hvad hvis jeg har brug for hjælp hurtigt? +
Kontakt os telefonisk — vi gør altid, hvad vi kan for at hjælpe hurtigst muligt.
Kan I hjælpe uanset opgavens størrelse? +
Ja, vi tager gerne både små og store opgaver og rådgiver dig om den bedste løsning.
